name: Unit converter
author: Alfie
description: Converts lengths, weights, temperatures and volumes, and counts the days between two dates. An example of an Alfie skill: it needs no permissions at all.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a number from one unit to another. Units: mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi; mg, g, kg, oz, lb, st; C, F, K; ml, l, tsp, tbsp, cup, floz, pt, qt, gal.

from.description: Unit to convert from, e.g. km

to.description: Unit to convert to, e.g. mi

tools.name: days_between
tools.description: How many days there are between two dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

prompt: Use convert_units for unit conversions instead of working them out yourself.
